name: ccwt
description: The ccwt worktree environment integration for Claude Code

plugins.name: ccwt
plugins.description: Tells a Claude Code session which services ccwt already runs for the current repository, stops it starting a second copy of one, lets it write the recipe that says what running the project means, and names the session after its worktree.

plugins.name: ccwt-mod
plugins.description: Shows what ccwt runs inside the Claude Code session: this session's worktrees, their services and links above the prompt, and a /ccwt pane with logs.
